video_title: 2026-27 Postgame Media Availability 🎙️ | Labaron Philon Jr. | 10.05.26

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on adjusting to defensive schemes and screen coverage
quotes.excerpt: just being ready to shoot and then I would say with the other coverages, switching high
quotes.quote: On the ball screens, some of the guys try to get under the screens, so just being ready to shoot and then I would say with the other coverages, switching high, being able to just attack immediately. I didn't feel any way during the game with the coverage changes. I was just trying to go out there and make a play. Being able to recognize it and trying to see what guys' tactics are and what the scouting report is, to get a feel of that, it was good. I got some different looks, so being able to watch the film and go back and try to correct things, I feel like that will be a good thing for me.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on adjusting to defensive schemes and screen coverage: I was just trying to go out there and make a play. Being able to recognize it and trying to see what guys tactics are and what the scouting report is, it was good.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the defensive challenge of guarding Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: just to not let him score, I would say, that would be the first thing
quotes.quote: Just to not let him score, I would say, that would be the first thing. Just try to keep him out of the paint as much as I can and definitely stay down. Watching him over the years and with me not being in the NBA and then being on the floor now, it's a surreal moment. Him posting me up over there in that corner, I was trying to see if he was going to try to score or not, but it was just a great feeling to see all those guys out there.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on the surreal experience of guarding Jalen Brunson: Watching him over the years and with me not being in the NBA and then being on the floor now, it is a surreal moment.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on learning from veteran teammates and team culture
quotes.excerpt: learning from the other guys on the team, the other veterans, and it's been going pretty well
quotes.quote: Being a great kid, always being on time, always watching the film, trying to put the extra hours in. I love the work, so putting in the extra work and learning from the other guys on the team, the other veterans, and it's been going pretty well. They've been telling me a lot of things I can use and a lot of things I can keep in my back pocket for resources. Tyrese, V.J., Jalen, LeBron, all those guys giving me heads up and stuff like that, it's been really great and I think that just instills more confidence.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. credits his veteran teammates for his early confidence: Tyrese, V.J., Jalen, LeBron, all those guys giving me heads up and stuff like that, it has been really great and I think that just instills more confidence.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the value of communication for a young point guard
quotes.excerpt: being able to use your voice and talk to the other guys, telling them what you see
quotes.quote: Those guys are eager to listen and learn, just like I am. Not being scared or afraid to talk, I would say, would be one of the most key things for a young player. Being able to use your voice and talk to the other guys, telling them what you see and what you feel. If you got a natural feel for the game, I feel like you can be really smart and direct things, so I feel like that's the way I'm training towards and I want to keep making strides.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on the importance of communication for a young point guard: Not being scared or afraid to talk would be one of the most key things for a young player. Being able to use your voice and talk to the other guys.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the mentorship provided by Tyrese Maxey
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese anytime he, you know, try to get me in a one-on-one situation, just talk to me
quotes.quote: Tyrese, anytime he, you know, try to get me in a one-on-one situation, just talk to me, just give me pointers and stuff like that, so it's been great. In shootaround today, he just told me to be myself, play at your own pace and do what you've been doing in practice.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on the mentorship he is receiving from Tyrese Maxey: Tyrese, anytime he tries to get me in a one-on-one situation, just talk to me, just give me pointers and stuff like that, so it has been great.
